content.comment_body: Hello, When attempting to download to the [product_name] [article_no], I receive the following message: 'You must use a newer version of this program.' I am using [product_name] V[version_no] (which I believe is the latest version). I also tried to download an empty program, but experienced the same issue. The PLC can be detected; its type is: [article_no] [version_no]. I'm not sure what the issue is here. (I used this software successfully last month on a different project.) Regards,

There isn't a '[article_no] [version_no]' device. There is either '[article_no]' or '[product_name] [version_no]', which are different. The [product_name] with order number [article_no] is considered a [product_name] [version_no] in the device selection.
I also selected [version_no] as the hardware type, so that should be correct, right?

For the [product_name] [article_no], you need to select [product_name] [version_no] in the device selection when creating your diagram (with or without blocks). Navigate to: Tools > Offline Settings > Hardware type.
Has your issue been resolved? If not, please upload your project as a zip file...
It's resolved. Both the configuration and program are now fine. The issue was due to incorrect IP settings. It's odd that the [product_name] displayed a 'version' message for that. Problem Solved.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered a misleading error message ('You must use a newer version of this program') during download to a [product_name] device. The actual cause was incorrect IP settings, but the software indicated a version issue, leading to confusion. While users navigated hardware and device selection accurately, troubleshooting was more complex than necessary due to vague feedback from the system.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear and specific error messages and a smooth deployment process when using matching versions of hardware and software. They also want issue guidance that reflects the true root cause during program transfer.
